name: EntrePass
summary: A pass for founders starting a Singapore company that is venture-backed or owns innovative technology. It is open to all nationalities, but you have to show funding, accelerator backing, a past exit, registered intellectual property or a research collaboration, so it rarely fits someone straight out of university.

requirements.text: Your nationality does not affect eligibility.

sources.quote: EntrePass is open to all nationalities/citizenships.

requirements.text: You must have started, or intend to start, a private limited company registered with ACRA in which you hold at least 30% of the shares, and which is venture-backed or owns innovative technologies.

sources.quote: Have started, or intend to start, a private limited company that is: Registered with ACRA (Pass holder must hold at least 30% of registered company) Venture-backed or owns innovative technologies .

requirements.text: You must also meet at least one of five criteria: funding raised, incubator or accelerator support, a technology business you founded and sold, registered intellectual property, or a research collaboration in Singapore.

sources.quote: Meet at least one of the following criteria: Raised funding for a past or current business
Supported by a government-recognised or internationally renowned incubator or accelerator
Founded and sold a technology business
Have a research collaboration in Singapore

requirements.text: The funding route needs at least SGD 100,000 raised in a single funding round from investors for any past or current business.

sources.quote: You have raised at least SGD 100,000 from a single funding round from investors for any past or current business.

requirements.text: If the company is more than 12 months old when you apply, you are assessed against the tougher renewal criteria instead.

sources.quote: If the registered company is more than 12 months old as of the date of application, you will be assessed according to the renewal criteria .

requirements.text: Some businesses are excluded outright, including food and drink outlets, bars and night clubs, massage and traditional medicine businesses, employment agencies and geomancy.

sources.quote: The following businesses are not eligible for an EntrePass: Coffee shops, hawker centres, food courts Bars, night clubs, karaoke lounges Foot reflexology, massage parlours Acupuncture, traditional Chinese medicine, herbal dispensing businesses Employment agencies Geomancy business
